I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
Totally get wanting to keep things budget-friendly. Based on what we offer, here are your best options:
Get a price quote: Your cost depends on your dog’s details (age, weight, activity level, recipes, zip code), so share those to get a tailored estimate.
Start with a trial: When you sign up, you begin with a 2‑week trial before regular deliveries every 4 weeks, so you can see if it fits your budget before long‑term planning.
Use retail options instead of (or alongside) a subscription: You can buy our meals through PetSmart, Amazon, or Chewy (online, and select PetSmart stores in person). That can give you more control over how often you buy and how much you spend.
Try a Variety Pack first: Our Variety Pack (via Chewy or Amazon) or single packs at PetSmart let your dog taste-test without committing to a full subscription right away.
Adjust your meal plan: In your account you can:
Change recipes (some choices may affect price)
Choose portion size (full or half portions if you want to mix with another food to stretch your budget)
Adjust meal packs per day so the supply matches your routine You’ll see an updated cost summary before saving changes.
If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
